This strategy is often associated with the idea of creating new markets or entering new industries, rather than competing in existing markets where established players dominate.

The blue ocean strategy is often contrasted with the "red ocean," which refers to saturated markets where competition is intense, and companies are locked in a value-destroying cycle.
